summary: Final publish batch tests on the preview, using isolated TEST_ clones only. Grouped actions (text and arrow move as one), seeded live offsets and fonts, Ambition spacing/height/width, the theatre link and the 3-way merge all PASS. One CRITICAL regression blocks publish: on all 10 public pages at 1920, 768 and 390px, the site header covers the top of the pinned LiveEditor panel, so a real mouse cannot click Save, Undo, Redo or Close. A one-line CSS fix, injected in the browser, made the panel smoke pass 43/43. The content package was cleaned and re-captured: 10 pages, no TEST data, identical to the 15:09 pre-test capture.

minor.issue: Out-of-date test assertion. The real preview settings now contain phone '+9100000', which was not created by tests. Not a product bug; update or skip the test.
test_contact_site_live and test_accent_lines fail with RuntimeError/AttributeError (event-loop/fixture sharing) when run in parallel. They pass when run serially with -p no:xdist -o addopts=''.

ui_bugs.issue: The panel is pinned at top:12px with z-index 100058, but it is rendered inside <main>. index.css:54 `.site > * {position:relative; z-index:1}` turns main into a stacking context at z=1. index.css:1604 `#public-site.site #site-header {z-index:30 !important}` overrides the intended `body.live-editing .header {z-index:1}` (index.css:1056). The header is 104px tall with a white background, so it covers the panel's top bar (Undo, Redo, Save, Close) both visually and for clicks. elementFromPoint(save) returns site-header on desktop and mobile-menu-toggle on 768/390. Playwright clicks on live-undo were intercepted by the header. Failed on every public page (10/10) and every state tested: load, image selected, mid-scroll, inspector scrolled, after drag/resize, 768, 390. The panel was previously at top 132px, below the header, which is why this was never seen before.

ui_bugs.component: LiveEditor Section background & spacing > Space top/bottom
ui_bugs.issue: Placeholder is hardcoded 'auto' (LiveEditor.jsx:695-696). It does not show the actual inner padding (64 desktop default). Only the layout padding inputs use padPH. Setting values works correctly.

ui_bugs.component: Selection handles near the right edge
ui_bugs.issue: For right-aligned items such as the home 'Explore Field Notes' link (x ~1636 at 1920px), the east resize handle sits under the 320px right panel, so elementFromPoint returns PANEL and the handle cannot be dragged. The west handle and inspector width work.

passed_details: Homepage Rakhigarhi card: 'Explore Rakhigarhi' visible, href /our-work/rakhigarhi, grouped (data-edit=items.0.link_label). Theatre deleted archive link absent. The existing Theatre link is grouped (text span + svg).

Clone with seeded LIVE styles: notes more_label (6.887/21.4/202/22px) and Get in Touch buttons.0.label (85/-42/143/22px). Both render at 22px on one line. Arrow vertical-centre offset 0px; gap 9px (notes) and 12px (Get in Touch). The transform is on the root only; text and svg both have transform 'none'. Other homepage title/text font sizes are identical to the real home.

Editor: clicking the arrow selects the whole action (selection box width equals root). Only [data-edit-text] is contenteditable. Inspector shows font 22. Font 26 stays aligned. Move X +40 moves text and arrow by exactly 40/40. Grip drag gives the same delta for both (-33/-33). West resize grows the width (265 to 311) on one line. Undo/redo keep the svg. Inline rename, then save (200 to clone), then DB has label and styles. Reload gives the same transform and width. Get in Touch and Our Work items.0 root/text roles are correct. Clearing the label saves '' and removes the action; the notes section stays.

Ambition clone (heading 28, body 18): default padding 72/64 at 1920 and 1440, 40/40 at 390. Footer gap 0 and edges match at all widths. Text-to-bottom gap equals the padding. Three boxes present, divider 70%. Padding-bottom 0 and 20 set the actual inner padding (height 573 to 509 to 529, not added on top). Padding-top 30 works. Minimum height 1200 grows the section; 200 shrinks only to content height with no clipping. Width 1000 is centred (220/220); 5000 is limited to 1339 with no overflow. Save writes paddings/width and keeps fonts. A fresh public context shows the same geometry (1100x550, 30/20); 390 has no overflow.
Header editor, Site text panel, add-section menu and image picker dialog are on top and clickable.
Backend: 7/7 new 3-way merge tests pass. Existing suite: 44 passed in the parallel run; contact and accent tests pass serially apart from 1 out-of-date phone assertion.
action_items: CRITICAL before publish: fix the panel stacking. Verified option (injected CSS, 43/43 pass): add `body.live-editing #public-site.site > main { z-index: auto !important; }` in site-overrides.css. Alternatives: render .live-panel through createPortal to document.body, or give `body.live-editing #public-site.site #site-header` a lower z-index with matching specificity. Then rerun /app/tests/iter19_editor_panel_stacking_smoke.py, which must show 43/43 without INJECT.
After any further clone tests, run /app/tests/iter19_final_capture_check.py (cleans TEST_ pages, calls capture(core.db), asserts 10 pages and no TEST).
Optional: show actual inner padding as the Space top/bottom placeholder; update the out-of-date phone assertion in test_contact_site_live.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Panel z-index raised to 100058 but it is still a descendant of main (stacking context z=1), so the z-index has no effect against the sibling header (z30 !important).

content_releases DB collection keeps intermediate releases captured while TEST clones existed (each capture upserts by release_id). The baked file is clean, but older DB release docs contain TEST pages. Harmless for deployment; consider pruning.
